title: Get medical help right away
intro: Day or night, do not wait, if you have any of these:

groups.title: Your baby, bleeding or fluid
signs: Your baby is moving less, has stopped moving, or the pattern has changed.
Any bleeding from your vagina while pregnant, even light spotting.
Fluid leaking from your vagina, or discharge that smells bad.
After birth: soaking a pad within an hour, or clots bigger than an egg.

groups.title: Breathing, chest or fainting
signs: Struggling for air, sudden breathlessness, or breathless when lying flat.
Chest pain, tightness or pressure, or your heartbeat changes: fast, pounding or uneven.
Fainting, memory gaps, or dizziness that lasts or comes and goes for days.

groups.title: Thoughts of harm
signs: Thoughts about harming yourself or your baby, or scary thoughts you cannot stop.

groups.title: Headache, eyesight, swelling or pain
signs: A sudden severe headache, or one that will not go away or worsens.
New changes in your vision: blurring, flashing lights, blind spots or seeing double.
Sudden swelling, or face or hands too swollen to open eyes or bend fingers.
Swelling, redness, pain or warmth in one leg or one arm.
Severe belly, shoulder or back pain, or belly pain that will not go away.
Pain below your ribs, or heartburn that heartburn medicines do not ease.
Any other pain that worries you.

groups.title: Fever, sickness and other signs
signs: A temperature of 100.4°F (38°C) or higher, or feeling very unwell.
Severe sickness: you cannot keep fluids down, or cannot drink for over 8 hours.
Suddenly very tired and weak, not like your usual tiredness.
Very itchy skin, itchy palms or soles, or itching worse at night.

action: Call your doctor, midwife or hospital. If you cannot reach them, call emergency services.
footer: Not on this list but worried about yourself or your baby? Call your doctor or midwife anyway.
